title: YouTube to MP3
intro: Record the sound of a YouTube video or a SoundCloud track in this tab and save it as an MP3. The page has no server to send anything to: it records and encodes the sound inside your browser, with no account and no adverts.
steps: Paste a YouTube or SoundCloud link below and press {here}. It plays on this page while it records.
When the browser asks to share this tab, keep the switch to share its audio on, and allow it.
Recording begins with the first sound and stops when the video or track ends. Then save the MP3.
Some owners keep their videos or tracks off other sites. For those, open it in a new tab, press {choose}, and click that tab in the browser's list.
link_open: Open it in a new tab
link_not_supported: That is not a YouTube or SoundCloud address. Copy the link from the address bar or from the Share button.
link_no_video: That address does not name a single video. Open the video itself and copy its link.
link_no_track: That SoundCloud address does not name a single track. Open the track itself and copy its link.
link_short: A short SoundCloud link cannot be read here. Open it, then copy the track's address from the address bar.
bitrate_note: A higher bitrate keeps more detail and makes a larger file. {default} kbps suits most listening.
rights: Record only what you have the right to keep, such as your own videos and tracks, or ones licensed for reuse.
browser_heading: Open this page in Chrome or Edge
browser_cannot: This browser cannot give a page the sound of another tab, so it cannot record here. Safari shares whole windows with no sound, and Firefox shares no tab sound. Chrome and Edge on a computer can, and both are free.
asking_text: The browser shows a list of your tabs. Click the tab with the video or track in that list, not in the tab bar at the top, turn on the switch to share its audio, and press Share.
asking_here_text: The browser asks to share this tab. Keep the switch to share its audio on, and allow it. The video or track then starts by itself.
waiting_text: Play the video or track now. Recording begins with the first sound.
waiting_here_text: The video or track is starting. If it does not play within a few seconds, press play on it.
recording_auto: Recording stops by itself after {seconds} seconds of silence.
recording_manual: Press {stop} when the video or track ends.
recording_here: Recording stops by itself when the video or track ends.
adverts: An advert that plays in the video's tab is recorded too.
tags_note: The title names the file. The title and artist are written into the MP3's tags, which music players show.
stopped_silence: Recording stopped after {seconds} seconds of silence, which is left out of the file.
stopped_limit: Recording stopped at the limit of {hours} hours.
stopped_ended: Recording stopped when the video or track ended.
no_audio: The tab was shared without its sound. Press {start} again and turn on the switch to share its audio.
picker_cancelled: No tab was shared. Press {start} to try again.
picker_failed: The browser did not share the tab ({detail}). Press {start} to try again.
no_sound: No sound was heard, so there is no MP3 to make. Play the video or track while the page is waiting for sound.
ended_early: Sharing ended before any sound was heard. Press {start} to start again.
player_blocked: The video's owner does not let it play on other sites. Open it in a new tab and press {choose} instead.
player_failed: The video could not play here (YouTube error {code}). Open it in a new tab and press {choose} instead.
soundcloud_failed: The track could not play here. Open it in a new tab and press {choose} instead.
bad_rate: The browser records at {rate} samples a second, which an MP3 cannot hold. Reload the page and try again.
